title: Authorized Medication Categories
rule_summary: Massachusetts law and current Board guidance authorize pharmacists meeting applicable conditions to administer specified categories of prescribed medications, including testosterone for gender-affirming care and other enumerated categories; the authority is not a general license to administer every prescription injectable.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
